$comment: The typed facade every binding exposes, described once.
Bindings have three layers. The DTOs are generated from walletkit's own
TypeScript types (scripts/generate-api). The transport — P/Invoke, JNI, Swift
C interop — is inherently per-platform and hand-written. This file is the layer
in between: the kit-ios-shaped object model, which is pure mechanics and so is
generated for every language by scripts/generate-facade.mjs.
Names are neutral camelCase; each emitter applies its own conventions (C#
PascalCase + Async, Swift async throws, Java CompletableFuture…). See
docs/BINDINGS.md.
Argument and return types. Anything not listed here is `dto:X` (a generated
walletkit model), `list<X>`, or `object:X` (another facade object, passed as
the id the ABI knows it by).
The specials exist because they are the same in every binding:
amount           an exact integer amount; walletkit sends it as a string
mnemonic         the word list, wrapped so it cannot be confused with prose
bytes            raw bytes; the ABI carries them as a JSON number array
chainId          optional network id, defaulting to the configured one
params           wallet parameters, which serialize themselves
fakeSignature    an optional bool that becomes a signing-options object
feature          a TON Connect feature

objects.name: Signer
objects.doc: A key that can sign (kit-ios TONWalletSignerProtocol).

methods.name: sign
methods.doc: Signs raw bytes; returns a hex signature.

objects.name: Adapter
doc: A wallet contract bound to a signer (kit-ios TONWalletAdapterProtocol).
It knows its address before it is registered with the kit, and it can sign —
but it cannot read the chain until it becomes a Wallet.

properties.name: identifier
properties.doc: The wallet id this adapter derives (kit-ios identifier()).

properties.name: network
properties.doc: The network this wallet lives on.

methods.name: stateInit
methods.doc: Deployment state init, a base64 BOC.

methods.name: signedSendTransaction
doc: Signs a transaction and returns the BOC.
fakeSignature produces a correctly shaped but unusable signature — right
for fee estimation, and what tests use so nothing can be broadcast by

methods.name: signedSignMessage
methods.doc: Signs a transaction as a TON Connect signMessage response.

methods.name: signedSignData
methods.doc: Signs prepared sign-data; returns a hex signature.

methods.name: signedTonProof
methods.doc: Signs a ton_proof message; returns a hex signature.

methods.name: supportedFeatures
methods.doc: TON Connect features this wallet advertises.

objects.name: Wallet
doc: A wallet registered with the kit (kit-ios TONWalletProtocol).
This is a handle, not storage: walletkit keeps wallets in memory only, so
after a restart the app rebuilds them from the persisted mnemonic.

properties.name: id
properties.doc: The kit's wallet id (a base64 hash, not network:address).

methods.name: balance
methods.doc: Current balance, in nanotons.

methods.name: transferTonTransaction
doc: Builds an unsigned TON transfer. The recipient must be in user-friendly
form (UQ…/EQ…): a raw address passes the early check and is then rejected
with a message that names the transaction, not the address.

methods.name: transferTonTransaction
methods.doc: Builds one transaction carrying several transfers.

methods.name: send
methods.doc: Signs and broadcasts. This spends real funds.

methods.name: preview
methods.doc: Emulates a transaction: fees, balance changes, actions.

methods.name: transferNftTransaction
methods.doc: Builds an NFT transfer.

methods.name: transferNftTransaction
methods.doc: Builds an NFT transfer from a raw message.

methods.name: nfts
methods.doc: NFTs this wallet holds.

methods.name: nft
methods.doc: One NFT by address, or null when the wallet does not hold it.

methods.name: jettonBalance
methods.doc: Balance of one jetton, in its own smallest unit.

methods.name: jettonWalletAddress
methods.doc: This wallet's jetton wallet address for a jetton master.

methods.name: transferJettonTransaction
methods.doc: Builds a jetton transfer.

methods.name: jettons
methods.doc: Jettons this wallet holds.

objects.name: Kit
objects.doc: The wallet kit: keys, wallets, and TON Connect (kit-ios TONWalletKit).

methods.name: initialize
methods.custom: Sends the configuration and records that the kit is up.
methods.doc: Builds the kit inside the core.

methods.name: generateMnemonic
methods.doc: Generates a 24-word TON mnemonic.

methods.name: signer
doc: Creates a signer from a mnemonic. The app must store the mnemonic
securely: walletkit persists neither signers nor wallets.

methods.name: signer
methods.doc: Creates a signer from a raw private key.

methods.name: createWallet
doc: Generates a mnemonic and derives a V5R1 wallet from it in one step
(kit-ios createWallet). The wallet is not registered yet — pass the

methods.name: walletV5R1Adapter
methods.doc: Derives a V5R1 wallet (the current default contract).

methods.name: walletV4R2Adapter
methods.doc: Derives a V4R2 wallet.

methods.name: add
methods.doc: Registers an adapter, yielding a usable wallet.

methods.name: wallet
methods.doc: One registered wallet by id, or null.

methods.name: wallets
methods.doc: Every registered wallet.

methods.name: remove
methods.doc: Unregisters a wallet. The chain is untouched.

methods.name: clearWallets
methods.doc: Unregisters every wallet.

methods.name: send
methods.custom: Delegates to the wallet, which is what actually holds the handle.
methods.doc: Signs and broadcasts a transaction from a wallet.

methods.name: addressState
methods.doc: Account state for any address: balance, status, last transaction. Needs no wallet.

methods.name: addressBalance
methods.doc: Balance of any address, in nanotons.

methods.name: addressTransactions
methods.doc: Transaction history for any address.
remarks: Currently throws for most addresses: walletkit's own response parser
toncenter does not always send. Upstream limitation, not a transport

methods.name: connect
methods.custom: Adds the tc:// scheme when the link arrives without one.
methods.doc: Handles a tc:// link. The dapp's request arrives as an event, not as the result of this call.

methods.name: sessions
methods.doc: Every live TON Connect session.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.doc: Ends a session.

requests.name: ConnectionRequest
requests.custom: Approving attaches the chosen wallet and may return the dapp's embedded follow-up request.
requests.doc: A dapp asking to connect (kit-ios TONWalletConnectionRequest).

requests.name: SendTransactionRequest
requests.doc: A dapp asking for a transaction (kit-ios TONWalletSendTransactionRequest).

requests.name: SignMessageRequest
requests.doc: A dapp asking for a signed message (kit-ios TONWalletSignMessageRequest).

requests.name: SignDataRequest
requests.doc: A dapp asking for signed data (kit-ios TONWalletSignDataRequest).

events.doc: One event from the bridge (kit-ios TONWalletKitEvent).

disconnect.doc: A dapp (or the wallet) ended a session.
